source.subject: Omspace Infinity One payload fairing and kickstage

observed_visual_structure: Dark opening followed by a low-angle industrial hangar shot
Two open carbon-look fairing halves flank a central metallic truss and upper-stage assembly
Camera tilt changes from ceiling-dominant to a fuller view of the assembly
Thin cyan outer frame, top-left brand, left information panel, right status panel
Top-center and bottom-right fairing wireframe diagrams, bottom-left vehicle outline
The shot fades to black before the end

adaptation.method: Procedural Blender scene, camera animation, screen-space HUD composition, original synthesized audio
intentional_changes: concept visualization labels in place of unverified flight or structural status
adaptation.engineering_claim: Visual concept only; not a computed flight or structural result
